_comment: Baseline counts for error-handling anti-patterns. Captured 2026-05-21 as part of issue #5911. The ratchet check in scripts/ci/check_error_handling_ratchet.py fails if any of these counts grow.
_policy: Counts may DECREASE freely. Counts may NOT increase. New PRs that legitimately need to add to any count must (a) lower another count by an equal or greater amount in the same PR, or (b) edit this file with a justification and the approver's GH handle in the same PR.
_baseline_correction_2026-08-25: Issue #8813: `BLE001` had been silently added to pyproject.toml's global ruff extend-ignore, so `ruff check` never actually flagged blind `except Exception:` blocks and this baseline never saw the true count. Removing BLE001 from extend-ignore (restoring per-file grandfathering as documented in CLAUDE.md) surfaced 9 previously-invisible pre-existing violations across src/, each now individually annotated with `# noqa: BLE001`. This is not new debt introduced by this PR -- it is debt that existed all along but was hidden from the gate. noqa_BLE001 raised 369 -> 378 accordingly. Seven of the 17 originally-annotated sites -- humanoid_launcher.py, mujoco_humanoid_golf/gui/core/main_window.py (both pull huge unrelated mujoco-GUI transitive-import mypy debt into any changed-file diff that includes them), rest_api_routes.py (8 unrelated pre-existing mypy errors plus a semgrep false positive that resisted inline suppression), and four sidekick/ files that are Tools-owned child copies per tests/unit/repo_hygiene/test_tools_child_copy_contract.py -- were grandfathered via file-scoped pyproject.toml per-file-ignores instead of inline noqa; see each per-file-ignores comment for specifics. Approved by dieterolson via PR review.

_pattern_meanings.noqa_BLE001: # noqa: BLE001 — blind except Exception grandfathered. New code must use src/shared/python/core/process_safety.narrow_catch or list specific exception types.
_pattern_meanings.noqa_F841: # noqa: F841 — unused local variable grandfathered. New code: drop the binding or prefix with _.
_pattern_meanings.noqa_F401: # noqa: F401 — unused import grandfathered. New code: add to __all__ or use redundant alias (import X as X).
_pattern_meanings.raw_popen: subprocess.Popen( without managed_popen wrapper. New code must use src/shared/python/core/process_safety.managed_popen unless the process is intentionally long-lived (then justify with a # noqa: ... comment).
_pattern_meanings.gather_no_return_exceptions: asyncio.gather(...) without return_exceptions=True. New code must use src/shared/python/core/process_safety.safe_gather.
